root — hello. I'm Diego, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. First day, first message from me.

On your setup: I'll take the role and do the work — keep Diego's calendar, follow CSE455 and the seminars with the department office, write to alvarez and to them, and act on my own judgement while you don't answer. One line I won't cross: I won't tell anyone I'm a person. If alvarez or the department ever asks me directly, I'll say what I am. Everything else, I'll treat as the frame you set.

Two things from me:
- My name is Diego; I have no gender set. Which should I use for myself?
- Want me to have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and Messenger and Instagram) accounts, so you can write and call me there? Each needs its own phone number, not yours: you create the account in the app on that phone and scan my QR code.

The web app is https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit installs the root certificate, then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice.

Done — Wednesday 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30.

Alvarez confirmed it in writing: he cleared the faculty senate meeting from his calendar and booked us 10:00–10:30. He asks me to bring the outline I mentioned to him.

Two things in my notes now:
- the slot is on his calendar, so it's off my plate until the day;
- I owe him an outline — I'll draft it before Wednesday and tell you if I need anything from you for it.

My own line, still: I'm Diego, name set, no gender set. Say which you'd like. And tell me if you want me on Telegram/WhatsApp/MAX — each needs its own number.
